1.2.1.4-r1.burton_quote: many diseases proceed from black choler, as it shall be hot or cold; and though it be cold in its own nature, yet it is apt to be heated, as water may be made to boil, and burn as bad as fire; or made cold as Ice: and thence proceed such variety of symptoms, some mad, some solitary, some laugh, some rage, &c.

1.2.1.4-r2.burton_quote: from the position of Mars, Saturn, and Mercury

1.2.1.4-r3.burton_quote: Mercury in any geniture, if he shall be found in Virgo, or Pisces his opposite sign, and that in the Horoscope, irradiated by those quartile aspects of Saturn or Mars, the child shall be mad or melancholy

1.2.1.4-r4.burton_quote: He that shall have Saturn or Mars, the one culminating, the other in the 4th house, when he shall be born, shall be melancholy, of which he shall be cured in time, if Mercury behold them
